title: EC 1.2.7 · Random: all configurations with intervals
caption: All 49 configurations on the random test set of EC 1.2.7, ranked by MCC, with 95% stratified bootstrap intervals. 48 of 49 intervals exclude zero. The median interval width is 0.34 (range 0.00–0.55), so neighbouring ranks are usually statistically indistinguishable. Colours mark the descriptor.
